documents.description:
THE CROWN'S LAST RUNG HAS A KNOWN WINDOW. Criterion 10 was REFUSED on cond_b (the 2200 MB export floor) and that refusal was CORRECT WHEN MADE — 18 consecutive samples failed the floor. It is not permanent. Resolved by pds-memory-floor-is-uptime-dependent-not-architectural: the floor is UPTIME-DEPENDENT. Measured 2026-07-20, same box, same floor, same day: beam ELAPSED 06:29:59 -> 0 of 10 samples clear (min 709, max 1555); beam ELAPSED 08:46 after a natural deploy -> 10 of 10 clear (min 2729, max 2821). THE JOB: schedule ONE serial `--all` climb immediately after a natural merge-triggered deploy, while the window is open, and pay rungs 3 and 4 off the one full bundle — or name what fails. WHAT IS NOT YET TRUE, STATED PLAINLY: nobody has run the full-fidelity export in this window. The window is measured; the export in it is NOT. This task may still end in a refusal, and a refusal naming the rung is a WIN in this epic. Do not open this task assuming the crown is payable. STANDING LAW, unchanged: never lower PDS_FULL_EXPORT_MIN_MEM_MB (banned, and the charter records it is already ~35 MB too NARROW against a measured 2235 MB demand on the LIVE content API); never manufacture a restart to open the window — auto-deploy on merge supplies fresh BEAMs free, and a deliberate restart forces the banner to retract 'nothing is written to the source'; the harness stays FROZEN at blob e219e97ccf7f33797c86a2b84d998d599b6bda31 and every red sorts into HARNESS BUG or ENGINE FAIL, both FILED, neither fixed mid-proof; report ATTEMPTS not successes as the budget. ALSO REQUIRED BY THE LEDGER: the crown now carries a 12th criterion, the SINGLE-RUN ATTRIBUTION FENCE. Only criterion 0 currently names a run id; criteria 1,2,3,4,5,7,8,9 carry evidence with NO run id. Paying criterion 10 from a fresh climb WITHOUT re-proving the others would be exactly the mosaic the fence exists to block. Either re-prove 0-10 from this one climb and stamp each with its run id, or refuse and say so.

THE WINDOW HAS A MEASURED DECAY CURVE — added by the lead 2026-07-20 ~14:15Z, same box, same day, four readings against the SAME 2200 MB floor:
  beam ELAPSED 06:51  RSS  245,708 kB  ->  MemAvailable 2719 MB   (CLEARS)
  beam ELAPSED 08:46  RSS  ~246,000 kB ->  10 of 10 samples 2729-2821 MB (CLEARS)
  beam ELAPSED 39:28  RSS  873,068 kB  ->  MemAvailable 1501 MB   (FAILS)
  beam ELAPSED 06:29:59 RSS 1,431,148 kB -> 0 of 10 samples, 709-1555 MB (FAILS)
So the window is NOT 'any time after a deploy'. It closed somewhere between 9 and 39 minutes of BEAM uptime, and the BEAM's RSS more than TRIPLED (246 MB -> 873 MB) across that span. Swap barely moved (689 -> 687 MB), so this is BEAM growth, not swap pressure. OPERATIONAL CONSEQUENCE: the climb must START inside the window, not merely after a deploy — budget on the order of ~15 minutes of uptime, and SAMPLE MemAvailable WITH the beam's ELAPSED immediately before firing (criterion 1 already requires this). A climb begun at minute 30 will fail cond_b and burn the wave. CAUTION, this curve is 4 points on ONE box on ONE day and the decay rate is NOT established — it may vary with traffic, and the export itself consumes memory once running. Do not quote '15 minutes' as a measured bound; it is a planning heuristic derived from 4 readings. Re-sample rather than trusting it.

Within the larger goal “Portable Data System crown — prove a full-fidelity workspace export under the frozen resource and attribution contract”, this task has a specific role: Blocks the crown's final seal because the export memory floor is uptime-dependent and no full-fidelity run has yet been attempted in the only measured passing window.

The larger portability goal requires one attributable run that proves the complete export, not isolated favorable samples. Earlier refusal was correct under low memory; this task uses the newly measured post-deploy window to test the unchanged contract without manufacturing conditions, preserving the crown's honesty whether the result passes or refuses again.

If omitted, the larger goal cannot truthfully claim this endgame: One frozen run id either proves the remaining crown rungs with sufficient memory and consistent attribution or becomes a documented, evidence-backed refusal with no weakened floor.

Zero exports fired; the floor was never lowered and the frozen harness never edited. 5 slices green + 1 charter-record slice filed by the review (D190-D203 landed; all five artefacts had been citing decisions the charter never defined). Review fixed a real defect: the sentinel guard against a manufactured green was bypassable by a non-numeric knob.
